comparison.objective: Extract a terminal from a connector, versus open an ampoule while retaining its cap in an opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-mediated tab release, versus protective enclosure placement and controlled scored-neck fracture while stabilizing the body.
comparison.success_condition: Undamaged terminal removal with neighbors retained; versus confirmed break, upright body, cap contained, opener returned, and hands released.
comparison.reason: The ampoule task tests protected fracture and fragment containment rather than nondestructive latch release.
